name: vid-editing
description: Remotion video editing project for social media content

scripts.build: npx remotion render src/index.ts SocialClipEdit out/social-clip.mp4
scripts.build:promo: npx remotion render src/index.ts BusinessPromo out/business-promo.mp4
scripts.build:social-ad: npx remotion render src/index.ts SocialAd out/social-ad.mp4
scripts.build:testimonial: npx remotion render src/index.ts TestimonialVideo out/testimonial.mp4
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:promo && npm run build:social-ad && npm run build:testimonial
